Short title

[THE SIND NON-AGRICULTURISTS LOANS ACT, 1928]
[THE SIND
NON-AGRICULTURISTS LOANS ACT, 1928]
SIND ACT No. III
OF 1928*
[*[For Statement of
Objects and Reasons, see B.G.G., 1928, Pt. V, p. 7 ; and for Proceedings in
Council, see Bombay Legislative Council Debates, 1928, Vol. XXII.]]
[30th March, 1928]
An Act to provide for the grant of loans by Government to
non-agri culturists for the relief of distress or other calamities and for the
recovery of such loans.
1. Short title. This Act
may be called " the *[Sind] Non-Agriculturists'
Loans Act, 1928".
*[Subs. by the Sind Laws (Adaptation,
Revision, Repeal and Declaration) Ordinance, 1955 (Sind 5 of 1955), s. 3 (i)
(w. e. f. 30th May 1951), for " Bombay ".]

Extent

[THE SIND
NON-AGRICULTURISTS LOANS ACT, 1928]
SIND ACT No. III
OF 1928*
[*[For Statement of
Objects and Reasons, see B.G.G., 1928, Pt. V, p. 7 ; and for Proceedings in
Council, see Bombay Legislative Council Debates, 1928, Vol. XXII.]]
[30th March, 1928]
An Act to provide for the grant of loans by Government to
non-agri culturists for the relief of distress or other calamities and for the
recovery of such loans.
2. Extent. Section I and
this section extend to the whole of the *[Province of
Sind]. The rest of the Act may be extended**
by the ***[Provincial Government] by
notification in the ****[Official Gazette] to
any part of the *****[Province] from such date
as "may be specified in such notification.
*[Subs. by W.P.A.O. 1964, Art. 2 Sch., Pt.
IV (c), for "the Province of Sind." The words, "Province of
Sind" were earlier subs. by Sind Ordinance 5 of 1955, s. 3 (ii) for
"Bombay Presidency."]
**[Sections 3 to 6 have been extended to
the Province of Sind, vide G. N., R. D., No. R-722-F dated 31st March, 1941,
see S. G. G., 1941, Ft. I, p. 988. ]
***[Subs. by the A. O., 1937, for "
L. G."]
****[Subs. ibid, for " B. G.
G."]
*****[Subs. by the Sind Laws (Adaptation,
Revision, Repeal and Declaration) Ordinance, 1955 (Sind 5 of 1955), s. 3(ii)
(e) (w. e. f. 30th May 1951), for " Presidency ".]

Purpose for which loans may be granted

[THE SIND NON-AGRICULTURISTS LOANS ACT, 1928]
[THE SIND
NON-AGRICULTURISTS LOANS ACT, 1928]
SIND ACT No. III
OF 1928*
[*[For Statement of
Objects and Reasons, see B.G.G., 1928, Pt. V, p. 7 ; and for Proceedings in
Council, see Bombay Legislative Council Debates, 1928, Vol. XXII.]]
[30th March, 1928]
An Act to provide for the grant of loans by Government to
non-agri culturists for the relief of distress or other calamities and for the
recovery of such loans.
3. Purpose for which loans may
be granted. Subject to such rules as may be made under section 6, loans may
be granted under this Act for rebuilding or repairing houses or for the relief
of distress to any person to whom a loan of under the Agriculturists' Loans
Act, 1884, cannot be granted, XII of 1884.

Loans already granted to be deemed to have been granted under Act

[THE SIND NON-AGRICULTURISTS LOANS ACT, 1928]
[THE SIND
NON-AGRICULTURISTS LOANS ACT, 1928]
SIND ACT No. III
OF 1928*
[*[For Statement of
Objects and Reasons, see B.G.G., 1928, Pt. V, p. 7 ; and for Proceedings in
Council, see Bombay Legislative Council Debates, 1928, Vol. XXII.]]
[30th March, 1928]
An Act to provide for the grant of loans by Government to
non-agri culturists for the relief of distress or other calamities and for the
recovery of such loans.
4. Loans already granted to be
deemed to have been granted under Act. All loans granted after the 1st day
of August 1927 to such persons as are "referred to in section 3 for the'
purpose mentioned therein' shall be deemed to be loans granted cinder this Act.

Recovery of loans

[THE SIND NON-AGRICULTURISTS LOANS ACT, 1928]
[THE SIND
NON-AGRICULTURISTS LOANS ACT, 1928]
SIND ACT No. III
OF 1928*
[*[For Statement of
Objects and Reasons, see B.G.G., 1928, Pt. V, p. 7 ; and for Proceedings in
Council, see Bombay Legislative Council Debates, 1928, Vol. XXII.]]
[30th March, 1928]
An Act to provide for the grant of loans by Government to
non-agri culturists for the relief of distress or other calamities and for the
recovery of such loans.
5. Recovery of loans.--*[*]All loans
granted or deemed to have been granted under this Act, together with all
interest (if any) chargeable thereon, and costs (if any) incurred in making or
recovering the same shall be recoverable at the discretion of the Collector in
any one or more of the following modes, namely :-
*[The figure and brackets "(I) "
rep. by Sind II, of 1928, s. 3, Sch. II. ]
(a) from the
borrower as if they were arrears of land revenue due by him ;
(b) from his
surety (if any) as if they were arrears of land revenue due by him ;
(c) out of the
assets left by a deceased borrower or surety or out of the property comprised
in the collateral security (if any)-according to the procedure for the
realization of land revenue by the sale of a defaulter's moveable or immoveable
property other than the land on which that revenue is due ;
(d) if the loan
is for the benefit of a house, out of such house,-as if it were arrears of land
revenue due in respect of the land on which the house stands.

Power to make rules

[THE SIND NON-AGRICULTURISTS LOANS ACT, 1928]
[THE SIND
NON-AGRICULTURISTS LOANS ACT, 1928]
SIND ACT No. III
OF 1928*
[*[For Statement of
Objects and Reasons, see B.G.G., 1928, Pt. V, p. 7 ; and for Proceedings in
Council, see Bombay Legislative Council Debates, 1928, Vol. XXII.]]
[30th March, 1928]
An Act to provide for the grant of loans by Government to
non-agri culturists for the relief of distress or other calamities and for the
recovery of such loans.
6. Power to make rules.--(I)
The *[Provincial Government] may, from time to
time by notification in the **[Official Gazette],
make rules*** to carry out the purpose of this
Act.
*[Subs. by the A. O., 1937, for " L.
G."]
**[Subs. ibid, for "B. G. G."]
***[For Rules, see G. R., R. D., No.
R/722/F., dated 12th February 1942.]
(2) In particular and without
prejudice to the generality of the foregoing power, such rules may be made for
the following matters namely:-
(a) the manner
of making applications for loans ;
(b) the officers
by whom loans may be granted ;
(c) the nature
of the security, if any, to be taken for the due application and repayment of
the money, the rate of interest at which and the conditions under which the
loans may be granted and the manner and term of granting loans ; and
(d) the instalments by which and the mode in which loans
shall be repaid.
